user.title: Tabula
user.description: Set up the Tabula hub. Tablets pair to it from the Tabula app on the tablet.

error.invalid_code: That is not the code shown on the tablet. Try again.

abort.already_configured: The Tabula hub is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration for this tablet is already in progress.
abort.expired: The pairing attempt expired or was replaced. Start pairing again on the tablet.
abort.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Start pairing again on the tablet.
abort.hub_not_loaded: The Tabula hub is not loaded.

unsupported_protocol.title: Tabula tablet speaks a newer protocol
unsupported_protocol.description: The tablet {device} tried to register with Tabula protocol {protocol_version}, which this Home Assistant's Tabula integration does not support (it supports {supported}). Update the Tabula integration, or install an older build of the tablet app. The tablet will keep retrying until then.

command_offline.message: The tablet is not connected, so the {command} command was not sent.

command_unsupported.message: The tablet does not support the {command} command.

command_invalid.message: The {command} command has an invalid value at {problem}.

command_timeout.message: The tablet did not answer the {command} command in time.

command_disconnected.message: The tablet disconnected before answering the {command} command.

settings_unavailable.message: The {setting} setting cannot be changed from Home Assistant yet; device settings arrive in a later release.

no_target_devices.message: The action did not target any paired Tabula tablet.

hub_not_loaded.message: The Tabula hub is not loaded.

notify.name: Show notification
notify.description: Shows a notification card on the targeted tablets.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text of the card. Limited Markdown is rendered.

level.name: Level
level.description: Severity: sets the stock icon and accent color.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds before the card goes away; 0 keeps it until dismissed. Omit to use the tablet's setting.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Material Design icon that replaces the level's icon.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: A new notification with the same tag replaces the old one.

navigate.name: Navigate
navigate.description: Opens a Home Assistant frontend path on the targeted tablets.

path.name: Path
path.description: Frontend path starting with /, for example /lovelace/kitchen.

screensaver.name: Screensaver
screensaver.description: Starts or stops the screensaver on the targeted tablets.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Screensaver to show when starting; omit to use the tablet's setting.
